@syntax Const name[type] = value[, name2[type] = value2 ...]
Gives a name to a value that cannot change. The value has to be given at once, and a name that is a constant cannot be assigned to. Constants can only be declared in the main program, but every function can use them. Names are not case sensitive, so `Const Limit = 3` and a variable called `limit` are the same name.

```blitzbasic
;run
Const WIDTH = 4, HEIGHT = 3
Const TITLE$ = "grid"
Print TITLE$ + " " + (WIDTH * HEIGHT)
```

```text
grid 12
```
